title: Sep 23 Results + Sep 24 Preview: When Baseball Keeps You Humble
summary: We split 8-8 on Sep 23, but here's the thing—tomorrow brings a fresh slate and Paul Skenes.

content.value:
## Here's the Thing About .500 Days

So we went 8-8 yesterday. Right down the middle. The baseball gods looked at our predictions, shrugged, and said 'sure, kid, you can have half.' And you know what? Some days that's just how this beautiful, infuriating game works.

We had some wins that felt good—the Yankees, Braves, and Orioles came through when we called them with 60%, 60%, and 54% confidence respectively. But we also had some head-scratchers, like the Pirates not showing up against the Cardinals despite our 55% backing.

content.title: Sep 23 Prediction Results by Confidence Level

content.value:
## The Silver Linings in a Split Day

Let me tell you what I loved about yesterday: our high-confidence picks went 3-2. When we really believed in something—60% or higher—we hit on the Yankees, White Sox, and Braves. That's the kind of pattern you want to see, even on a day that ends at .500.

The Orioles doubleheader sweep? *Chef's kiss*. We called both games, and Baltimore delivered both times. Those are the moments that remind you the model knows what it's doing, even when the overall record doesn't sparkle.

## Tomorrow's Top Pick: The Paul Skenes Factor

Now let's talk about September 24, because here's where things get interesting. We're going right back to the Cardinals-Pirates well, except this time Paul Skenes is on the mound for Pittsburgh.

Kyle Leahy gets the ball for St. Louis, and while he's had his moments, facing Skenes at PNC Park is a different kind of challenge. Our model gives the Pirates a 51% edge—barely over the coin flip line, but when you factor in Skenes' electric stuff and the home crowd energy, sometimes 51% tells a bigger story than the number suggests.

content.title: ⭐ Tomorrow's Top Pick - Sep 24
content.value: Pittsburgh Pirates over St. Louis Cardinals
content.sub: 51% win probability • Paul Skenes vs Kyle Leahy • PNC Park

content.value:
## The Story Behind the Numbers

Yesterday the Pirates let us down with a 55% pick. Today we're trusting them again at 51%. That's baseball, friends. You don't hold grudges. You look at the matchup, you trust your process, and you make the call.

Skenes brings the kind of dominance that can flip a tight probability into a convincing win. He's been one of the best stories of this season, and when he's dealing, the Pirates become a completely different team.

So yes, we split yesterday. And yes, we're going right back to the Pirates tomorrow. Because that's what you do when the numbers and the narrative align. You trust the process, you embrace the story, and you see what September baseball brings.

Let's get back over .500 tomorrow. ⚾

author: Hana
